description: This file defines the ImportMapAct class, which extends ImportMapOther, to provide import mapping configurations specifically tailored for ACT! files within the SuiteCRM project. It includes metadata, licensing information, and methods to retrieve default mappings for specific modules.

classes.name: ImportMapAct
classes.description: A class that extends ImportMapOther to define import mappings specifically for ACT! files in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: getMapping
methods.description: Returns module-specific default field mappings, extending the parent method with additional mappings for 'Contacts' and 'Leads'.
